title.vi: Lệnh Nhập cư (Miễn trừ theo Điều 36(1)) 2022
title.th: คำสั่งการตรวจคนเข้าเมือง (การยกเว้นตามมาตรา 36(1)) 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1. This Order is the Immigration (Exemption from Section 36(1)) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 23 May 2022.
[S 1046/2024 wef 31/12/2024]

2.—(1) Subject to sub-paragraph (2), section 36(1) of the Act does not apply to a person who is removed from or otherwise lawfully sent out of Singapore after being informed under section 24(2), 25(2), 25A(2) or 26(3) of the Act that the person is prohibited from entering Singapore.
(2) Sub-paragraph (1) does not apply to a person who is removed from or otherwise lawfully sent out of Singapore for any other reason at any time before, during or after the application of section 24(2), 25(2), 25A(2) or 26(3) of the Act to the person.
[S 1046/2024 wef 31/12/2024]
